change.title: 5. SSG General Ledger — Correct Abacus 1.x scope and retain later Abacus 2 integration
change.reason: Replace the former BPI scenario with the author-requested independent SSG General Ledger partnership. Use the confirmed story dates: agreement 1977-07-28, team/development 1977-08-12, vanilla CP/M/CBASIC release 1978-01-15 and joint AION C/General Ledger Aurelia launch on the morning of 1978-06-06. SSG retains application ownership and sales; AION funds bounded porting and later networking work, not an equity investment. Preserve stable legacy record IDs for reference and review continuity; displayed identities and product scope are SSG General Ledger. Exact original GL/runtime revisions and speed ratios remain unverified. See review_evidence/ssg-general-ledger for source distinctions, scope and validation. Revised against author feedback change_review.1065e77b-8905-4302-a025-0d92b6b6738f: Abacus 1.x, including the Model II edition, must not claim Pulse access or formatted table/report layouts. Remove the legacy programmatic-file-access claim and printed-form feature as well as correcting chapters 1 and 2. Retain the direct SSG summary-file import into ordinary worksheet cells. Abacus 2 retains its later Pulse and report/layout capabilities; no advanced Abacus 3 storage/query features are moved into 1.x. Original before snapshots and feedback history remain unchanged.

change.title: 12. SSG General Ledger — Remove the business/accountant pilot event
change.reason: The author requests removal of event.bpi_pilot. Remove the already approved event and its owning development-process step atomically. Preserve the separate compiler, financial-regression, recovery and release checks already specified in the port; do not introduce another pilot event or invent a replacement date. The July agreement, August development start, January CBASIC release and June joint launch dates remain unchanged.

before.title: SSG General Ledger business and accountant pilot programme
before.description: Target 10–15 pilot businesses and several accounting practices for the Aurelia C/TUI General Ledger. Reconcile the January CBASIC release and port against identical records, including postings, corrections, period-end totals and reports. Exercise TUI data entry, backup/restore, interruption recovery, disk-full and memory limits. Pilot participation does not itself establish acceptance.

inputs.description: The native C/TUI candidate is the application under test.
The released vanilla CP/M/CBASIC application provides the reference results and comparison baseline.

outcomes.description: Record reconciled financial results, supported resource limits and unresolved defects. Measure responsiveness on the same Aurelia configuration without inferring speed from language alone; approve only configurations that pass recovery and financial checks.

before.title: SSG General Ledger AION C/TUI port
before.description: Develop and qualify the Aurelia adaptation of SSG’s General Ledger. The existing ledger work supplies the application semantics; AION contributes tools, integration and focused implementation support. The CBASIC release and C/TUI port remain distinct products.

inputs.description: The agreement establishes the port scope and funded responsibilities.

steps.description: Form the joint team and begin development.
Port ledger logic and explicit decimal routines first; use regression fixtures while SSG independently completes its CBASIC release.
SSG releases the vanilla CP/M edition; freeze a copy and its runtime for regression and same-machine comparisons.

Integrate bounded TUI forms, lists, account tables, selection controls and buttons with shared editing, Tab navigation, shortcuts and copy/paste. Link measured assembly kernels and use the ROM TUI through documented bank-safe calls.
Run business and accountant qualification pilots.
Complete reconciled reports, migration checks, error/recovery tests, resource measurements and instructor preparation. Hand over a reproducible release build for the June 6 joint presentation.

outcomes.description: Deliver SSG’s native Z80 C/TUI General Ledger adaptation, source/build material, reconciled regression suite and maintenance documentation for its June 6 release. Qualification records identify supported configurations; SSG retains release and application ownership.
